?:?:_Z14eval_far_batchPN4gicc9DeviceCtxE.rationale: Const 4KiB put in a known 64-trip loop, coalescable and hk_capable, with flops_to_first_use=5392 giving slack to hide host staging. Per-op staging 1.033us vs proxy issue 2.872us makes batched DWQ release cheaper despite higher fixed cost.

?:?:_Z16eval_reuse_batchPN4gicc9DeviceCt.rationale: 32-trip constant loop on grid_blocks=1 gives proxy no lane parallelism: 5.37+32*2.872=97us vs trigger 7.88+32*1.033=41us; descriptor_reusable=true further amortizes staging.

?:?:_Z16eval_tiny_singlePN4gicc9DeviceCt.rationale: Single 256B op, no loop: proxy 5.37+2.872=8.24us vs trigger 7.88+1.033=8.91us. Lower fixed cost wins at op count 1, but margin is small.

?:?:_Z17eval_large_singlePN4gicc9DeviceC.rationale: One 1MiB transfer is bandwidth-bound (~43.7us at 24GB/s); single-op issue-path delta is <1us (~1.5%), so evidence does not justify pinning a lowering. Keep IPC_OR_DWQ baseline.

?:?:_Z19eval_adjacent_batchPN4gicc9Devic.rationale: 16-trip constant loop, coalescable, single block so proxy serializes on one lane: 5.37+16*2.872=51us vs trigger 7.88+16*1.033=24us.

?:?:_Z19eval_dynamic_offsetPN4gicc9Devic.rationale: Only legal action: descriptor not host-reconstructible (hk_capable=false, dynamic offset operand), so the device op must be preserved with CPU proxy work.

?:?:_Z21eval_static4_parallelPN4gicc9Dev.rationale: Independent static site, one op; grid_blocks=4 <= proxy_worker_lanes=8 so the four sites issue concurrently on distinct lanes, and single-op proxy cost (8.24us) is below trigger (8.91us).
Distinct independent callsite of the same kernel: 4 producers <= 8 lanes gives full concurrency; at batch_size=1 proxy's lower fixed cost dominates.
Independent static site with one 4KiB const-size put; distinct lanes available (4 < 8), so parallel ring issue beats serialized host descriptor staging.
Fourth independent static site; lane budget still covers all producers and proxy fixed cost 5.37us < trigger 7.88us at op count 1.
